input: Write a one-page business plan for my consulting idea

gold.taskTitle: Write a One-Page Business Plan for Consulting
gold.taskDescription: Create a concise, one-page business plan for the user's consulting business idea.

questions.title: What specific industry or field is your consulting in?
questions.description: Identify the consulting domain (e.g. marketing, HR, finance, IT, etc.) to tailor the plan.

questions.title: Who is your target client — businesses or individuals?
questions.description: Clarify whether the consulting is B2B, B2C, or a specific niche within those.

questions.title: What core problem do you solve for clients?
questions.description: Understand the primary pain point or value proposition the consulting addresses.

questions.title: Have you already landed any clients or revenue?
questions.description: Determine whether this is pre-launch, early-stage, or already generating income.

questions.title: How do you plan to price your consulting services?
questions.description: Capture the intended pricing model — hourly, retainer, project-based, etc.

questions.title: What is your main channel for finding new clients?
questions.description: Identify the primary go-to-market or outreach strategy the user has in mind.

questions.title: Who is the intended audience for this business plan?
questions.description: Clarify whether the plan is for personal clarity, a partner, investors, or a bank loan.
